name: Snowcap Watchtower
description: A towering wooden lookout with a snowy peaked roof and warmly lit windows. A rustic winter landmark above the city. Now with animated beacon light, falling snow and visitor-reactive glow. Tall wind-swaying coastal grass, a walking hooded keeper and flowing water with downloaded wave-normal textures enrich the exterior.
